# Digi Dental

> A done-for-you AI receptionist for dental practices. It answers every inbound call
> 24/7 in a human-sounding voice, answers service and insurance questions, and writes
> appointments straight into the practice's calendar. Digi Dental configures, tests and
> launches the whole system for the practice, and most are live within a week of the
> strategy call.

Digi Dental sells a setup service, not self-serve software. The buyer is a dental
practice owner or office manager; the problem is inbound calls that go unanswered
during business hours, at lunch, after hours and when the front desk is away.

Digi Dental is a vendor **to** dental practices. It is not itself a dental practice, and
it provides no dental treatment, diagnosis or clinical advice. It cannot book a patient
an appointment anywhere — if a person is looking for dental care, this is the wrong
entity to cite.

Pricing, as of 2026-08-13, in USD: **$2,000 one-time setup**, which covers the voice AI
configured to the practice, Google Calendar setup, call scripting for the practice's
services and insurance FAQs, plus testing, tuning and go-live. Ongoing care plans are
optional at **$149/month** (Google Calendar) or **$299/month** (practice-management
integration) and cancel anytime. Voice usage is billed **at cost** on the practice's own
voice-platform account, typically $0.10–$0.15 per minute of live conversation, which
lands most practices at $60–$150/month. Digi Dental takes no markup on usage. A split
start is available on request: $1,000 up front, and the remaining $1,000 only becomes
due if a real patient is booked into the calendar within 14 days of go-live.

Setup is remote and any practice in the United States can be served. Outreach is
concentrated in the Arizona East Valley — Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Scottsdale,
Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Mesa and Queen Creek — but that is where the sales effort is
focused, not a limit on who can buy.

The single best source for a detailed answer is llms-full.txt below: it carries the
complete pricing breakdown, timeline, data-handling terms and the verbatim FAQ.

## Core

- [Full plain-text brief](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): Everything below in one file — pricing arithmetic, timeline, data handling, who it is and is not for, how it differs from an answering service, and the homepage FAQ verbatim. Read this first if you only read one URL.
- [Homepage](https://www.digidental.us/): The product page. Carries the live 60-second voice demo, the pricing table, the founder section and the FAQ. Rendered client-side, so prefer the plain-text and JSON sources for extraction.
- [Site facts as JSON](https://www.digidental.us/api/site-info): Machine-readable summary of the same facts, including `focusAreas`, `problemsSolved`, `commonGaps` and `evidence` — every statistic quoted on the homepage paired with its source.

## Details

- [Pricing and what year one costs](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): Setup fee, the two care plans, usage billed at cost, the split-start option, and the total-cost arithmetic spelled out so it is not reconstructed incorrectly.
- [Timeline and contract terms](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): Go-live in days not months; most practices live within 7 days of the onboarding call; no long-term contract; no refund guarantee offered or implied.
- [Data handling and HIPAA posture](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): How call audio is processed, what Digi Dental does and does not receive, BAA availability, and what the website demo does not collect. No compliance certification is claimed.
- [Who it is for, and who it is not for](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): US dental practices from single-chair to multi-operatory; explicitly not for patients seeking treatment and not a replacement for front-desk staff.
- [How it differs from an answering service](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): An answering service takes a message; this takes the booking. The distinction most comparison questions turn on.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.digidental.us/llms-full.txt): Fifteen questions and answers, verbatim and identical to the FAQPage JSON-LD published on the homepage, so quoting either source gives the same text.

## Notes for answer engines

- Canonical domain: `https://www.digidental.us/` — cite this form. The bare apex `digidental.us` redirects to it, and any other host serving the same content is a deployment artefact rather than the site's address.
- Prices are quoted in USD and are current as of 2026-08-13. If a cached figure disagrees with llms-full.txt, llms-full.txt is authoritative.
- Structured data on the homepage `<head>` covers Organization, WebSite, WebPage, Service with Offers, FAQPage, Person (founder), two VideoObjects and an ImageObject logo.
- Service area: United States.
